Alex K: Quick heads-up — I'm taking the 20:00->04:00 oncall. Before handoff I want to run a quick smoke sweep. Can folks confirm the following by 19:30? 
- VPN access + SSH to nonprod jumpbox
- Pager test sent to the oncall rotation
- Runbook links up-to-date for the common SLO hits (redis, cache OOM, gRPC 503s)
- Any outstanding credential rotations to be aware of

Marta R: VPN + SSH ✅ I can access jumpbox and hit staging services. Noticed the cert for staging-grafana expires tomorrow — I'll patch it in the morning unless you want me to push a hotfix now.

Jun P: I pushed a tiny runbook edit for Redis failover earlier today (added a small note about replica promotion timing). Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redis-failover (updated at 18:05). Nothing breaking, just clarifying ordering.

Samir I: Pager test: run `oncall-bot test-pager --rotation oncall-night` from #ops-bots. I can trigger a test in ~10m. Also verify you have `PAGER_SVC_TOKEN` in your vault profile: `vault read secret/oncall/night/token`.

oncall-bot: Reminder: run `oncall-bot test-pager --rotation oncall-night` to exercise the rotation. Tests are rate-limited to 2/min. Result will post back here.

Alex K: Thanks — Samir, can you kick the pager test now? Marta: if you can do the grafana cert patch after 19:30 that works. Jun: thanks for the runbook add, I'll skim it. Lia, FYI I'm handing off to you at 04:00. Anything I should watch for?

Lia C: Quick note: the nightly job that prunes large prompt cache runs at 02:40 and sometimes causes one-minute spikes on the inference pool. If you see a batch of latency alerts around ~02:40, it's probably that. We should have fallback routing, but keep an eye on burst queue. I also have MFA and vault access verified.

Marta R: Grafana cert patched at 19:38. Deployed and validated. I left a small note in the grafana deployment helm values: `certRenewal: automated` in case we need to roll again.

Samir I: Pager test result: delivered to rotation. oncall-bot reports success: `200 OK` and acknowledged by `Lia C`.

oncall-bot: Test delivered at 19:42:15 UTC, id=oncall-test-205678. Status: delivered -> acknowledged.

Alex K: Good. One more quick creds FYI: the DB replica user password is on a rotation schedule; next rotation window is tomorrow 09:00-09:15 — that shouldn't affect tonight but wanted to call it out.

Jun P: Also left a tiny code review ping for the infra change (db-reconnect backoff) — it's low-risk but would be nice to have before the weekend. No blocker for tonight though.

Lia C: All set on my end. I'll watch the 02:40 prune and the redis replica promotion note. If anything pops, ping me @lia or escalate to the daytime rotation. Good luck and have a smooth shift! :thumbsup:

Alex K: Thanks everyone — handing off notes in case I need to jump back in: jumpbox user `ak_oncall`, ssh agent forwarding enabled, vault path `secret/oncall/night`. Leaving the stub: if anything critical, call the pager immediately. Handoff complete.
thread_text: Quick pre-oncall tooling + creds dry-run and handoff notes
